description: arXiv:2603.02041v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on English-centric data, resulting in uneven performance for smaller languages. We study whether continued pretraining (CPT) can improve Estonian capabilities in multilingual LLMs while preserving English and general reasoning performance.
